thread.text: concernign the regularization, people are moving away from dropout. Nowadays we use many different techniques for batch normalization, and dropout is being used less and less (because we don't want to waste part of our weights). We should focus more on the idea that since models have lot of parameters, regularization is required in order to make sure we don't overfit.
In general, for these ML topics and SBI, you can also query the "gensbi - paper" notebook, which has more ML specific information relevant to modern SBI methods

I think that this section needs to be better scoped

density estimation is a very broad task, which is being tackled with MCMC, beside SBI methods like NF for NPE, NLE, as well as NRE methodologies, diffusion models etc. So this is a very broad landscape that can be tackled from many point of views. We should make it clear that here we want to introduce some information about the methodologies that are actually being used in ch 5
in general, this part on density estimation needs reframing
